resources.string: General guidance for understanding trade, loans, and e-commerce. It does not replace specialised religious guidance or legal advice for an actual contract.
Contract, finance, and legal details vary by country. Have the actual agreement reviewed by a qualified scholar and legal adviser before committing to it.
Search by ticker or company name, then open a licensed Islamic screening database to review the status, report, and methodology.

This release does not embed licensed screening data. The entered ticker is copied, then the selected provider page opens; the app does not independently issue a Shariah verdict or an investment recommendation.
API integration needs provider approval and a key. It can be enabled in a later release after the appropriate licence is supplied.
Enter a ticker or company name first.

Financial notice: screening results are informational only, not investment advice or a solicitation to buy or sell. Review the provider report and a qualified adviser before making a financial decision.
Record debts owed to you and by you with the amount, due date, and a local reminder. The app does not upload these details automatically.
The Qur’an instructs: “write it down” for a fixed-term debt (2:282). This ledger supports organisation and does not replace a contract or legal documentation where needed.
A local reminder at 09:00 on the due date
Enter the other party and a positive amount, and verify the date format if supplied.
A reminder cannot be scheduled for a past date or without a due date.
A debt with %1$s for %2$s is due.
